failure_symptoms: allInStock reports true as soon as a single item is in stock, so a catalog with an out-of-stock row still reads as fully stocked.

f2p: is false when any item is out of stock
p2p: is true when every item is in stock
lists three stocked or unstocked rows

tell_audit.notes: The diff swaps every for some; the all-vs-any symptom must be inferred from the call sites.
